· 현재가($269.54) vs SMA5/20/50($290.39/$322.78/$329.18): 단기·중기 추세 하회, 약세 구간 진입 확인

[지지·저항 구조]

· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Lower High 형성 가능성): 5일 고가($315.00) < 20일 고가($370.55), 약세 추세 지속

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($269.54) vs SMA5/20/50($290.39/$322.78/$329.18): Below short/mid-term trends, confirming entry into bearish territory.
· Position vs SMA100/200($306.33/$240.71): Mid-to-long-term trend weakening, above SMA200 but below SMA100.
· 52-Week Position (56.8%) + Historical Significance: 30% down from 52-week high, 128% up from 52-week low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (49.2 → 30.2): Entering oversold territory, confirming strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.0191 → -6.0061): Continued worsening, signaling strengthening bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower Band $273.52): Approaching lower band, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($253.59): Approximately 6% below current price, near SMA200 support ($240.71).
· Swing Resistance ($275.87): Approximately 2% above current price, first resistance zone on short-term bounces.
· 5-Day/20-Day High/Low Pattern (Potential Lower High): 5-day high ($315.00) < 20-day high ($370.55), bearish trend continues.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.41x): Increased volume during decline, confirming selling pressure.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Downtrend): Bearish pressure is dominant due to RSI oversold and MACD worsening. Maintain a wait-and-see approach, requiring further indicator confirmation.
